summary: Built 1937 as a 20-ft L-4 pole tower in the Umatilla National Forest; now gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: The register and firelookout.org say the tower is gone; the Oregon index says removed. No source gives a removal year.

events.note: Built in 1937 as a 20-foot L-4 pole tower, per the Former Fire Lookout Sites register.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Three short listings agree the tower is gone (or removed) and give the 1937 build; no source gives a removal year, cause, staffing, fires, or any description of the site today, so the story says only what the register says. Oregon index URL (meacham.html) returned the full state index, not a detail page. firelookout.org has no Meacham detail page (404). WebSearch and websearch.py found no Meacham-specific history. Wikipedia's Meacham, Oregon article does not mention the lookout. The '20' L-4' figure is recorded as design, not height_m, because the register does not say whether 20 ft is tower height. Access is unknown in the brief and no source covers it, so no access fact is set.
